risks.title: Feed Cost Volatility
risks.explanation: Fodder prices fluctuate heavily during dry seasons, impacting monthly margins.
risks.potentialImpact: Margin reduction of up to 15% during summer.
risks.mitigationAdvisory: Enter into forward contracts with local farmers for dry fodder.

risks.title: Disease Outbreak (Cattle)
risks.explanation: Foot and mouth disease or mastitis can halt production entirely.
risks.potentialImpact: Total loss of production for 2-4 weeks; potential loss of livestock.
risks.mitigationAdvisory: Ensure strict vaccination schedules and veterinary insurance.

risks.title: Competition from Cooperatives
risks.explanation: Large cooperatives might launch aggressive price-cut campaigns in the village.
risks.mitigationAdvisory: Focus on the premium 'farm-fresh' USP rather than competing on price.

why.summary: Premium pricing is justified by direct delivery and unadulterated quality guarantees.
